notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check for RTIambassador::deleteRegion and its HLAreportServiceInvocation delivery through the standard MIM. Region lifecycle behavior maps to clause 9.1.2; successful service invocation reporting and its interaction content map to clauses 11.5 and 11.5.1. The scenario creates a region with service reporting disabled, enables service reporting, deletes the region, and checks the standard region-designator argument, null return marker, success and empty-exception fields, serial zero, region service type 5, reliable delivery, and inherited HLAfederate reporter identity. A repeated delete verifies InvalidRegion and its failure report at serial one. The subject then attempts to delete a region created by the observer, verifies the official API-declared RegionNotCreatedByThisFederate exception, and checks the failure report's supplied Region designator, serial two, and reporter identity. These exception/report checks are supplemental API-boundary evidence and do not add an immutable requirement mapping. Finally, the deleted subject-owned region is verified as no longer queryable through the standard API with reporting disabled. The scenario makes no region-based routing assertion and does not claim complete failure-report coverage. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard 1516.2 MIM data elements, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration.
